suggestions.topic: Native AA implementation decision: Frames (EIP-8141) vs EIP-8130
suggestions.rationale: Deferred decision from ACDE #243 with explicit expected revisit at this call (Aug 27). AA breakout on Aug 25 will surface concrete comparison and required modifications for final implementation decision.

Gloas fork was scheduled for ~Aug 21 (Thursday 7:50 AM UTC, ~1 week after ACDE #243). This call is 6 days after activation — critical to review any issues encountered during fork transition and confirm testnet stability.

suggestions.topic: History expiry window convergence for Hegota
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #243 flagged urgent need for history expiry at Hegota given 200M gas limit impacting 2TB node operators. Clients remain divergent (6 months to 1 year). Async discussion ongoing but requires synchronous decision on spec location and window.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7928 BAL disagreement in Hive chain tests (block 57)
suggestions.rationale: Hive chain PR #1589 blocked since ACDE #242 on client disagreement over EIP-7928 BAL contents at block 57. No resolution documented in ACDE #243. Potentially blocking Glamsterdam testnet graduation if not resolved.

suggestions.topic: Hegota headliner selection process and timeline
suggestions.rationale: FOCIL confirmed as headliner; native AA CFI'd pending convergence (now resolved via Aug 25 breakout). EL client preference lists due Sept 10 (ACDE #245). Should clarify next steps for CFI decisions and headliner scoping.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8268 (storage routes in block access lists) presentation
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDE #241 (July 16) with expected revisit 'next ACDE.' Author Carlos was absent then and presentation has not occurred in subsequent calls. PFI'd for Hegota but needs formal presentation.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7923 (Linear Memory Costing) spec update and max-memory report
suggestions.rationale: Jochem committed to spec update and max-memory report within 2 weeks of ACDE #243 (Aug 13). This call is 14 days after — status update warranted to confirm PFI readiness for Hegota CFI consideration.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam EIPs promotion to Review status and SFI milestone
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #241 and #242 noted 7 Glamsterdam EIPs pending promotion to Review and SFI milestone confirmation with testing team. With Platåberget now live and stable, should confirm whether EIPs have progressed and SFI criteria met.
